title: RTEC reasonable accommodation authority and process map

current_authority.scope: General employment accommodation commitment for applicants and employees who need accommodation because of disability or to practice/observe religion, absent undue hardship.
Pregnancy, childbirth and related-medical-condition accommodation guidance, including a timely good-faith interactive process and examples of accommodations.

historical_rtec_sources.scope: Historical RTEC AAP states that reasonable accommodation may include changes to the application process, work environment or manner/circumstances of work, and equal access to employment benefits/privileges; it identifies a historical EEO contact.
Historical manager/supervisor training reinforces accommodation awareness and fair employment practices.

useful_reference_topics: limiting medical-document requests to information relevant to disability/functional limitation and accommodation need
keeping medical information confidential and separate from ordinary personnel records
reassignment as a possible last-resort accommodation in the federal-agency framework
tracking requests, outcomes, processing time and technical-assistance sources
external_reference_only.authority_warning: This source describes federal-agency procedures under Executive Order 13164 and related federal-sector guidance. It is not evidence that all of those procedures, deadlines or reporting duties are RTEC policy.

current_process_model: Receive an accommodation request or otherwise identify that an applicant/employee is requesting an employment-related accommodation.
Determine the accommodation domain: disability, religious practice/observance, pregnancy/childbirth/related medical condition, or another potentially applicable current policy/process.

For pregnancy/childbirth-related requests, use the current handbook's timely, good-faith interactive-process requirement to identify an effective accommodation rather than requiring leave when another reasonable accommodation can be provided.
For disability or religious accommodation, apply the current signed EEO policy's accommodation commitment and undue-hardship boundary while consulting any current detailed procedure that may exist.
Collect only the documentation needed under the governing current process; keep medical or other sensitive case information in restricted case storage rather than generalized GitHub knowledge.
Document the request, interactive discussion, decision, accommodation or alternative, effective dates and any follow-up/review needed.
Escalate uncertain, legally sensitive or policy-conflicting cases to the appropriate current HR/EEO decision-maker rather than relying on historical templates.
pregnancy_examples_from_current_handbook: time off to recover from childbirth
temporary transfer to a different job
private space other than a bathroom to express breast milk
privacy_controls: Accommodation requests and supporting medical information are person-level sensitive records and must remain outside the generalized GitHub knowledge corpus.
Generalized knowledge may retain the workflow, role responsibilities, form/template identity, non-identifying aggregate metrics and source provenance.
Do not infer disability, pregnancy status, religion or medical facts from a request beyond what the individual supplies for the case.
conflicts_and_gaps: No current standalone RTEC disability/religious accommodation SOP or request form has yet been established from the ingested sources; the current signed EEO policy states the obligation but not a detailed intake/decision workflow.
The historical AAP names earlier EEO role-holders and must not be used for current routing.
The external Executive Order 13164 reference contains useful controls but cannot silently fill gaps in RTEC's current procedure.

Current accommodation decision authority, documentation standards, response targets, reconsideration path and retention rules remain to be confirmed from a current RTEC-specific source or user confirmation.
automation_candidates: Restricted accommodation intake/case tracker separated from general personnel files and generalized knowledge.
Current-policy-aware interactive-process checklist by accommodation type.
Reminder/follow-up dates for temporary accommodations and review points.
Aggregate accommodation metrics that exclude medical details and identities.
